description: Join us for compelling, challenging, and honest discussions, guided by our 2026 Festival theme: Samarasā: Awareness. Empathy. Action. The four-day programme will be guided by the theme Samarasā: Awareness. Empathy. Action., which comes from Sanskrit philosophy and emphasises the harmony between Citta (mind), Rasa (heart), and Karsa (action). It invites reflection on how thought, feeling, and action can exist in harmony. We explore the forces that shape us to find a perfect balance of awareness, empathy, and action. From the technological to the spiritual, the personal, and the environmental, we trace the cycles of our existence, not just to understand where we have been, but to guide humanity toward where we must go: a future defined by compassionate response. We are also thrilled to reveal this year’s artwork by Balinese artist Wayan Aris Sarmanta, a young talent whose work originates from his hometown’s Batuan painting style. There are more than over 100 events taking place across Ubud, featuring over 150 of Indonesia's and the region's most exciting authors, actors, journalists, poets, and thinkers. name: George Harliono & Hera Hyesang Park
location: Padma Resort Legian, Jl. Padma No.1, Legian
description: The Padma Musical Series George Harliono & Hera Hyesang Park Padma Resort Legian, Bali — Saturday, 12 December 2026 The Padma Musical Series concludes the year with one of the most distinguished classical pairings ever to grace a Bali stage. George Harliono needs no introduction to Padma audiences. The British-Indonesian pianist and Silver Medallist at the XVII International Tchaikovsky Competition returns following his unforgettable appearance at the series. Having performed at the Royal Albert Hall, Wigmore Hall, Berlin Philharmonie, Suntory Hall and Chicago Symphony Center, George has established himself as one of the most distinctive pianists of his generation. Joining him is Hera Hyesang Park — the acclaimed Korean soprano celebrated by the Financial Times as a ‘pristine, diamond-cut soprano.’ An exclusive Deutsche Grammophon recording artist, she has performed at the Metropolitan Opera, Staatsoper Berlin, Glyndebourne Festival and Paris Opéra, as well as alongside the New York Philharmonic, Los Angeles Philharmonic and Vienna Symphony. Her Bali debut promises to be something truly special. Together, they promise an unforgettable evening of extraordinary musicianship, vocal brilliance and artistic chemistry. ● 20% discount for BCA card holders ● 40% discount for general seating in the BRONZE section purchased with a student ID Tickets: https://megatix.co.id/events/george-harliono-hera-hyesang-park
